description: This file contains utility functions for creating mock data, configuring lifecycle setups, and testing webhook interactions related to Zalo messaging in a test support context.

methods.name: createLifecycleConfig
methods.description: Generates a configuration object for a Zalo lifecycle with specified parameters.

methods.name: createLifecycleAccount
methods.description: Creates a mock ResolvedZaloAccount object with given parameters.

methods.name: createLifecycleMonitorSetup
methods.description: Returns an object containing both account and config for lifecycle monitoring setup.

methods.name: createTextUpdate
methods.description: Constructs a mock text message event object.

methods.name: createImageUpdate
methods.description: Constructs a mock image message event object.

methods.name: createImageLifecycleCore
methods.description: Sets up mock functions and core object for image lifecycle testing.

methods.name: expectImageLifecycleDelivery
methods.description: Asserts that image delivery functions were called with expected parameters.

methods.name: settleAsyncWork
methods.description: Performs a small delay loop to settle asynchronous operations.

methods.name: postWebhookUpdate
methods.description: Sends a POST request to a webhook URL with specified payload and secret.

methods.name: postWebhookReplay
methods.description: Performs two webhook POST requests, optionally settling in between, to simulate replay.
